note: The Falco line and the families of the Valle Caudina it married. State is derived from what this archive actually publishes: a line is DRAWN only where a chart of it exists, DRAWABLE where there are enough people to chart and no chart yet, and a ROUTE where there are too few.

rows.name: Falco
rows.what: Nine documented generations in one valley — the line this archive carries, and the only one of these that is charted.

rows.name: Crisci
